content.title: Revaluation Alpha
content.abstract: Factor returns combine two sources of performance: a structural component, the return from fundamentals and income, and a revaluation component, which arises when a factor’s valuation ratio changes. It is important to distinguish these two sources of return. If revaluation has zero unconditional expected return, it adds noise to estimates of expected returns in finite samples.
